for r in range(3,9):
    v=ws.cell(row=r,column=4).value
    if v is not None and str(v).strip():
        colors.append(str(v).strip())
print('colors',colors)
for r in range(2,18):
    a=ws.cell(row=r,column=1).value
    text=str(a) if a is not None else ''
    tl=text.lower()
    found=''

        if c.lower() in tl:
            found=c
            break
    ws.cell(row=r,column=2).value=found
    print(r,repr(a),'->',repr(found))
wb.save(p)
print('saved')
